name: NICK'S HOUSE
blurb: A small house in West Egg, and rather too many crates.
how: Drag and fling every crate out through the doorway before the clock runs out.

win.title: A HONEST HOUSE
win.body: All {count} crates sit out on the porch and the little parlor is bare — swept, squared away, and as honest as its tenant. Somewhere across the bay, a party is starting without you.
win.quote: I am one of the few honest people that I have ever known.
win.cite: F. Scott Fitzgerald, The Great Gatsby

lose.title: THE WEIGHT OF THINGS
lose.body: The clock runs out with the boxes still stacked against the wallpaper. The house keeps its weight of borrowed furniture and unfinished business.
lose.quote: So we beat on, boats against the current, borne back ceaselessly into the past.
lose.cite: F. Scott Fitzgerald, The Great Gatsby
